address: 19 Khyber Pass Road, Grafton, Auckland, 1023, New Zealand
bio: The large open kitchen through the arch at the end of the narrow room is the domain of Chef-owner Fraser McCarthy, who has run this restaurant since 2017. Whilst he does offer a seasonal and good value à la carte menu of handsome-looking dishes like gurnard with courgettes, or Ebony Black Angus beef with asparagus, your best bet is to go for the full experience and enjoy the five- or eight-course tasting menu of dishes chosen by him. The room has a cool, contemporary feel. If it’s date night, ask for one of the intimate booths.
